items.title: Bitcoin-Backed Lending Surges 62% as Xapo Bank Members Leverage BTC for Real Estate
items.why: Crypto-collateralized lending is a niche signal, not a near-term partner lead for card lending programs.
items.summary_ai: Bitcoin-backed loans at Xapo Bank reportedly rose 62% as members borrowed against crypto to buy real estate.
items.take: Crypto-collateralized lending is a niche signal, not a near-term partner lead for card lending programs.
